.@RichardHaass asked what I would do about the destruction of jobs. I called for an investment bank, 1,000 trade schools and tech institutes, a care economy, and capital for places left out. I call it economic patriotism.

The problem in America is too few people in too few places control too much of our nation's wealth. @Morning_Joe

Video

Proud of my alma mater! I was fortunate to pay off my 100k plus in higher education loans. This will make an enormous difference to have working and middle class kids get a Chicago education.


The University of Chicago (@UChicago)

UChicago is launching an initiative that will guarantee free tuition for families with incomes below $250,000, starting in fall 2027. The College will provide free housing and meals and waive fees for families with incomes less than $125,000. Learn more: ms.spr.ly/60

.@Timodc is an unorthodox thinker calling for an independent and anti-status quo politics and coalition. That's what the times call for. And any student of FDR knows he was not an ideologue, but a democratic experimentalist who tried novel and unconventional approaches!


Tim Miller (@Timodc)

Khanna, Massie, Lurie, and Zohran have demonstrated how anti-status quo politics can work for people with different ideologies. The Dems need more creative destruction and laboratories of reform. 

My case

We are lucky to have your leadership and moral clarity @ChristaleSpain in this moment. I too am grateful for what @CoryBooker @GavinNewsom have done to stand up for voting rights.


Christale Spain (@ChristaleSpain)

Good Partners are invaluable! Thank you @gavinnewsom @CoryBooker and @RoKhanna for helping fight the fight in the Deep South on redistricting. Your investment of financial resources  helps in this effort and helps elect Democrats at every level. #flipthefuture

Hoping Wheeler, Schwarber and Phillies stay hot tonight. Mattingly off to quite the start. I used to have his rookie card...

Trump attacked me this weekend for talking about job losses & higher prices on Fox News. 

Now, he says he doesn’t think about Americans’ financial situation.

Is it too much to ask an American President to care about Toledo more than Tehran?


More Perfect Union (@MorePerfectUS)

Reporter: “To what extent are Americans’ financial situations motivating you to make a deal? [with Iran]”

Trump: “Not even a little bit…. I don't think about Americans’ financial situation”

“Every day we were on US soil, there was Black resistance.”

I sat down with @chrisrabb in Philadelphia to talk about Black leaders paving the way for the progressive movement. Republican officials are attacking the work of the Civil Rights Movement, and we must fight back.

Video

If we were not at war, the Fed would have cut rates 2-3 times this year. Now it will likely be zero.

Americans are paying more for their mortgages, more for credit cards, more for student debt & more for food and gas.

All b/c Trump went along with Netanyahu's Iran war.

Trump promised to bring prices down.

Prices under his policies are up.
 
Inflation is 3.8 now. It was 3.0 when he started.

His betrayal of his base in launching a war in Iran has been an absolute disaster.

The next Democratic White House does not need a court reform commission like some college seminar.

We need action.

We need term limits for Justices.

We need to expand this morally bankrupt Court from 9 to 13.
